summary_en: ¥2,000M authorization to acquire up to 900,000 shares (5.8% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) at no disclosed price ceiling via open-market purchase. Execution window Jul 1 to Sep 18, 2026. Rationale: flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Share Buyback
translation_en_brief: Toyo Kanetsu announced on 22 June 2026 a board resolution to acquire treasury shares under the authority granted in its articles of incorporation and the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 900,000 shares (5.8% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an aggregate maximum of ¥2,000 million via open-market purchase under a discretionary management contract (取引一任契約) from 1 July to 18 September 2026. The stated purpose is to enable flexible capital-allocation execution. At the reference date (31 May 2026), the company held 461,254 treasury shares out of 16,046,148 total issued shares, leaving 15,584,894 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
